heading: I make things for the internet.
body: I'm Sarib. I design things for the internet and I run a small studio called Xtarc, while building my own tools on the side.

I started out drawing art in MS Paint, cartoons in PowerPoint, making logos for friends, learning html, redesigning apps I didn't like and so on in roughly 2019. Somewhere along the way I realised I cared less about making things pretty and more about why some things just work. Why one page makes you trust a business and another makes you close the tab, even when they say the same thing.

That curiosity has pulled me in a lot of directions: brands, websites, funnels, software, AI and video. I've stopped trying to pick one, because it all serves the same goal, helping a business look and work like it means it.

Most of my days are spent in Figma, Framer and lately a lot of code. When I'm not doing client work, I'm usually building small apps for myself, running a meme page that has no business being as popular as it is, or practising talking to a camera.
